How to write a Field Procedure (guide) article on EDFM.

== A guide is not a second encyclopedia article ==
If the subject already has a Main-namespace reference article (e.g. [[Broo Tarquin]], [[Multi-Cannon]]), don't re-explain what it is, what it specialises in, or its lore here — link to the reference article and keep this page to the actionable checklist. [[Unlocking Broo Tarquin]] is the worked example: it never restates Broo Tarquin's specialties, only what a commander needs to do to reach him.

== Title ==
Flat, human-readable, action-shaped title — e.g. <code>[[Unlocking Broo Tarquin]]</code>, not <code>Guide:Unlocking Broo Tarquin</code>. Same no-namespace convention as every other article on EDFM.

== Starting from the skeleton ==
Create the page and, as your first edit, enter <code><nowiki>{{subst:New guide page}}</nowiki></code>, then fill in the placeholders. The skeleton's sections are: Objective, Prerequisites, Required Materials/Equipment/Access, Estimated Time, Step-by-Step Procedure, Expected Result, Common Mistakes, Troubleshooting, Related Reference Pages, Relevant External Tools, Sources. Only include a section if it actually applies — an empty "Estimated Time" saying "not applicable" is fine, but don't pad a section that has nothing real to say.

== Cross-link both ways ==
Once your guide exists, add a link to it from the reference article's Related Guides section (see how [[Broo Tarquin]] links to [[Unlocking Broo Tarquin]]) — a guide that nothing points to won't get found.

== Don't invent steps ==
Same rule as everywhere else on EDFM: leave a step, quantity, or requirement as "to be added" until it's actually checked, rather than guessing at something plausible. See [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Source Quality Guide]].
